text:
Maya: Heads-up: we need a decisive routing policy for incoming design partners. target: classify into Standard / Fasttrack / Concierge so onboarding teams can plan. Can we finalize today?
Jon: Agree. biggest constraint is Fasttrack GPU capacity. don't want accidental overcommit.
Priya: Draft signals: (A) sustained monthly inference QPS estimate, (B) data sensitivity flag (PII/regulatory), (C) integration complexity in dev hours, (D) existing infra (cloud vs on-prem).
Sam: +1. For simplicity I vote to keep 3 primary signals (QPS, PII, complexity) and treat infra as a tiebreaker.
Elena: UX requirement: partners should see the reason for route. small explanatory text next to their assignment.
Maya: Two choices: rule-based vs scored. rule-based easier to reason about; scored gives nuance. Thoughts?
Jon: Rule-based with buckets for QPS is safer initially. buckets: <1k, 1k-10k, >10k. Also PII true -> Concierge immediately.
Priya: If we go rules only, edge cases will cause churn. Proposal: hybrid: PII=true => Concierge; otherwise if QPS>10k => Fasttrack unless complexity>40h then Concierge. else Standard.
Sam: That hybrid is clear. ops-wise we can implement fast. but we should add a feature-flagged scoring path later.
OpsBot: Note: staging routing table updated at 2026-03-24T14:00Z for QA. simulation endpoint: POST /intake/simulate-route with body like `qps_bucket: ">10k", pii: true, complexity_hours: 45`.
Maya: Add rollback plan: global flag to force all new signups into Standard for 24h. Jon, please draft the RFC for the flag and short-run service behavior.
Jon: Will do. API stub: `POST /v1/intake/route` -> returns {"route": "Concierge", "reason": "PII"}. I'll PR to recruitment/routing-service branch.
Elena: Email copy suggestion: "Thanks — we've matched you to our Concierge onboarding due to data sensitivity. A member of our team will reach out within 48 hours." include contact link and next steps.
Priya: Metrics to track in week 0: acceptance rate (target >65%), onboarding drop-off (<25%), time-to-first-successful-call (<72h). Also watch for route flipbacks in analytics.
Maya: Action items: Jon owns feature flag + routing service (ETA EOD tomorrow). Priya builds synthetic intake dataset + dashboard (ETA Tue). Elena updates invite copy (ETA today). Sam to confirm Fasttrack capacity w/infra (ETA EOD).
Sam: Confirmed I'll check reserved GPU pools and call out if we need an extra 4 slots for Fasttrack.
Priya: Also request: weight partner responses so one very large partner doesn't dominate aggregate metrics.
Maya: Good catch. add sample weighting in analytics. Closing — will reopen when PR lands. :raised_hands:
